scope: Run exactly one profile at a time on both RTX 3090s; one unscored short warmup and nine scored requests in preregistered order.
startup: Pinned Control 0.1.51 strata serve --profile <config> --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8350 --offline --ready-file <private absolute path> --shutdown-timeout 90.
gates: Lock token must remain Q146 owner token before each arm.
No PeritoSoft/llama-server/Strata serving process or listener may already be active.
Offline plan must pass and explicitly show --gpu 0,1.
Server must allocate >=1024 MiB additional memory on each 3090.
Abort on OOM counter increase, GPU temperature >=85 C, PSI full avg10 >=60 or some avg10 >=80 for 15 consecutive 10-second samples.
PSI warning full>=20 or some>=70 for 30 samples is recorded and does not itself abort.
MemAvailable and swap are recorded, not stand-alone abort thresholds.
cleanup: SIGINT only to this runner-owned process group; wait for drain; verify port 8350, ready-file, serving processes, GPU and memory post-state before next arm.
